description: This Java source file defines a class 'InterestPrincipalPenaltyFeesOrderLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor' that implements a specific strategy for processing loan repayments in the Apache Fineract project. It enforces the order of interest, principal, penalties, and fees during repayment, including handling early and late payments.

classes.name: InterestPrincipalPenaltyFeesOrderLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
classes.description: A custom transaction processor for loan repayment that prioritizes paying interest first, then principal, penalties, and fees, for both on-time and late payments.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the internal strategy code used to identify this repayment processing strategy.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name of this repayment processing strategy.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsPaymentInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Processes early or advance payments, handling them similarly to on-time payments, with interest paid first.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsALateRepaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Processes late repayment transactions, paying interest first, then principal.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsOnTimePaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Processes on-time payments, ensuring interest is paid before principal, penalties, or fees.

methods.name: handleRefundTransactionPaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles refunds by un-applying payments from fees, penalties, principal, and interest in that order.

methods.name: isInterestFirstRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Indicates that this processor prioritizes interest payments before others.
